name: morning-tab
description: A personal newspaper inside ChatGPT and Codex, built with OpenAI MCP Extensions.

interface.shortDescription: Your internet, edited into a morning paper
interface.longDescription: Open your personal newspaper from the global sidebar or beside a conversation. Configure reading sources with native plugin settings, then ask your current conversation to prepare a sourced edition. Runs as a local MCP server. No separate model API key, nested Codex process, browser extension, or background schedule. Browser-history input requires a separately available authorized browser integration.
